title: Movies above their genre's average runtime
statementMd:
List movies longer than the average runtime of their own genre.

Expected columns: `title`, `genre`, `runtime_minutes`.

Tables: `movies`, `directors`, `reviews`.

Row order does not matter.
solutionMd:
```sql
SELECT m.title, m.genre, m.runtime_minutes FROM movies m WHERE m.runtime_minutes > (SELECT AVG(m2.runtime_minutes) FROM movies m2 WHERE m2.genre = m.genre);
```
